notes.title: Patch 7th May, 2018
notes.content:
We've been working on the new update for weeks. Finally we're here!!

[h1]Features[/h1]

[list]

[*]Added Emote Panel. To achieve it by pressing the Menu Button on left controller.
[*]Added VR & Desktop mode selection on login interface.
[*]Added new component VideoPlayer for playing the video on SDK. Link: http://www.pararea.com/doc_en/download
[/list]

[h1]Optimization[/h1]

[list]
[*]Adapted Oculus Rift and Windows MR.
[*]Optimized the Height Settings.
[*]Optimized movement.
[*]Optimized Desktop Sharing.
[*]Optimized user experiences.
[/list]

notes.title: New Patch on 11th April, 2018
notes.content:
Greetings, we delayed our update schedule because we’ve fixed tons of issue and added more features in both client and SDK.
Let’s check it out!

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Portal function on Space entrance, now you can invite your friend into a same space.
[*] Added hand gestures on VR mode, it is functional locally, we will fix that synced gestures on next patch.
[*] Added player height adjustment function.
[*]  Added Friend System on keyboard mode.
[/list]
[h1]SDK Trigger[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added onHoldAndUse for setting an object can be picked up and used.
[*]  Added onInteract for setting an object can be interacted.
[/list]
[h1]SDK Event[/h1]
[list]
[*]  Added SetMaterial for changing material of objects.
[*]  Added PlayParticle for triggering a particle.
[*]  Added PlaySound for triggering playing audio.
[*]  Added Animation Float, int and bool adjustment.
[/list]
[h1]SDK Component[/h1]
[list]
[*]  Added Portal for setting a portal in a space to transport any direction you want.
[/list]
[h1]Optimization[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed avatar movement issue, especially on locomotion mode.
[*] Fixed known bugs.
[/list]
Feel free to contact us and join our community for reporting more bugs and chating on discord https://discord.gg/SWG4aCG


大家好，很抱歉我们延迟了更新进度，这2周内我们做了大量的研发和修复bug的工作，请查看以下的版本信息。



[h1]新功能[/h1]
[list]
[*] 增加了传送门，现在你可以邀请你的朋友们进入同一个场景。
[*] 在VR模式内新增了手势，现在你可以通过触摸触控板来变换不同的手势。同步功能将在下个补丁中增加。
[*] 新增了身高调整功能。
[*] 键鼠模式内新增了好友功能
[/list]
[h1]SDK Trigger[/h1]
[list]
[*] 新增了onHoldAndUse来设置一个物品可以被拾取且可被触发。
[*] 新增了onInteract来设置一个物品可以被用来交互触发某个事件。
[/list]
[h1]SDK Event[/h1]
[list]
[*]  新增了SetMaterial，现在可切换物品的材质。
[*]  新增了PlayParticle，现在可触发粒子特效。
[*]  新增了PlaySound，现在可触发播放声音文件。
[*]  现在可调整动画的float, int, bool这3个参数。
[/list]
[h1]SDK 控件[/h1]
[list]
[*]  新增了传送门，现在可在场景内放置传送到其他场景的传送门。
[/list]
[h1]优化[/h1]
[list]
[*] 修复了人物移动时身体抽动的问题。
[*] 修复了已知问题。
[/list]
有任何问题欢迎加入我们的QQ群[b]697539785[/b]或者加入我们的discord https://discord.gg/SWG4aCG 参与讨论。

notes.title: Patch on 23rd March, 2018
notes.content:
Features


1. Added more locomotions on VR mode, as smooth move and turn (They might cause dizzy).

2. Added TeleportPlayer Receiver Action about SDK, review the tutorial about it on Developer Documentation: http://www.pararea.com/doc_en/tutorials/TeleportPlayer-Tutorial

3. Added PlayAnimation Receiver Action about SDK, review the tutorial about it on Developer Documentation: http://www.pararea.com/doc_en/tutorials/PlayAnimation-Tutorial



Fix and Optimization


1. Fixed Audio issues.

2. Optimized SDK pack size.

3. Optimized the tedious process of adding Par_PickUp (Script) in the SDK.

4. Known bugs fixed. Feel free to contact us and join our community for reporting more bugs and chating on discord https://discord.gg/SWG4aCG


新增：


1. 丰富了VR模式的操作，现在移动和转身都支持不同的模式切换，按键也做了修改。左手柄的触摸板用来移动，按右手触摸板用来做转身和跳的动作。


更多手势绑定将在下个版本中完成。敬请期待。


2. 在SDK中新增了空间内的传送事件 - TeleportPlayer，使用方法请访问开发者文档查阅：http://www.pararea.com/doc_cn/tutorials/TeleportPlayer-Tutorial


3. 同时SDK中另外一项新功能是触发动画事件 - PlayAnimation，使用方法请访问开发者文档查阅：http://www.pararea.com/doc_cn/tutorials/PlayAnimation-Tutorial


优化和修复


1. 优化了语音问题。


2. 优化了SDK体积过大的问题。


3. 优化了SDK中设置可拾取物品脚本添加繁琐的问题。


4. 修复了已知bug，如果有更多问题请参加我们的QQ群 697539785参与讨论。


 Discord： https://discord.gg/E5S4kq7

SDK：http://www.pararea.com

notes.title: Update on 2nd March
notes.content:
Features
1. Added avatar eye-blinking animation.
2. Added synced lips animation.

Optimization
1. Optimized audio experience.
2. Optimized avatar dance actions.
3. Optimized SDK.

Plan
1. Planning to re-work keybord mode interactive experience and add object interaction.
2. The SDK will support Trigger Event, you can customize playable scene with that.
3. Working on different components in SDK, such as Mirror, HoloBooth, Portal, Object SitAble, Object PickUp. 
4. Will update the new Scene Template interactive logic.

功能更新
1. 支持avatar表情眼部动画
2. 支持avatar嘴部同步动画

产品优化
1. 优化了语音效果
2. 优化了固定跳舞动作的效果
3. 优化了SDK

近期计划
1. 键鼠控制模式和增加键鼠交互。
2. 增加SDK Trigger Event 的支持，自定义好玩的场景内容。
3. 增加镜子、展示台、传送门、物品可坐、物品可抓取的控件。
4. 全新场景的模板及实例交互。

notes.content:
[b]Features[/b]
1. Support the scene custom upload, please follow the official website and check out the Pararea SDK on http://www.pararea.com/ .

2. Added dancing animation, now you can achieve your character dancing on keyboard mode.

2、增加了在键盘模式下左右移动的角色动画。
3、修复了VR模式进入模型骨骼扭曲的问题。

notes.title: Weekly Update Dec.27th,2017
notes.content:
Features
1.Added Clap motion
2.Added Writing Board in Lobby
3.Added in-game keyboard
4.Added character lip sync animation

Optimization
1.Optimized physical mechanism
2.Optimized user experience

Next Plan:
Avatar customization
Customize your appearance in the changing room. Different type of body including full and doll body with lip sync, eye blinking and complete range of motion.


产品功能
1.新增拍手效果
2.大厅中新增手写板
3.新增3D键盘，输入无压力
4.支持嘴部动画和声音同步
优化
1.优化了一些物理机制
2.优化了用户体验

下一步计划：
定制Avatar
在更衣室里定制你的形象。制作自己的任何类型的形象，嘴唇同步，眨眼和动作。

notes.title: The major updates in Nov.10th:
notes.content:
1. Added new scene: The Lobby. Let you have faith for the future.
2. Added new UI, which makes you better interaction experience.
3. Added new activity: Soccer. Now go play with your friends for fun!
4. There are many kinds of things can be played in lobby, such as baseball, basketball, BBQ and golf. Go explore them.
5. Optimized the avatar system, avatar action and added height fitting function.
6. Fixed known bugs.

Current Plan:
1. We are now working on the desktop sharing function! Next time you can share the contents in your PC to your friends.
2. New avatars and outfit changing system.
3. New tutorials.

3、新手引导优化
